lines: Raridon's role has grown lately. He played 71% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 57% on the season, and saw 3.7 targets per game.
Over those 3 games he averaged 3.8 PPR points, with 1.7 catches and 21.0 receiving yards per game.
In Week 12 NE is at LAC with an implied team total of 17.0 points. LAC allows the 23rd-most PPR points per game to tight ends.
